options.label: secure
options.consequence: Protection stays on. Ask the user for the passwords (user password at least 10 characters); downloads and online access to the CPU then need them.

options.label: testOnly
options.consequence: Lowers security: confidential PLC configuration data (keys, certificates, passwords) are stored unencrypted and the CPU has no access protection (protection level full access). Only for test projects, and only when the user agrees.

nextSteps: Ask the user which option of securityPrerequisites.options applies and run its operations before compiling, downloading or TiaNetwork(hmiConnectionIntegrate).

notices: The new CPU does not compile until its security settings are configured; see securityPrerequisites (master secret, UMAC user with Full access, protection level password).
